1.explanation:
In Carbon’s Tabs component you can already render an “icon-only” tab by using the renderIcon + iconDescription props on Tab. This sample shows both the line and contained styles side by side:

1. Without a size prop (40px default height)
2. With a custom size="large" prop (expected 48px height)

Currently, even if you pass size="large", the component stays at 40px. This reproduces the bug so you can see that the `size` prop is not being applied. Once the size prop is wired up, the second row in each set should grow to 48px tall and adjust its internal padding (e.g. 20px from icon to underline or container border).
1.bug_scenario: The issue affects the “icon‐only” Tab variant (both line and contained styles): there is no way to switch between the two required heights (40 px default and 48 px large). As you can see in the mock (first row is 40 px tall, second should be 48 px), the Tabs component currently always renders at the default 40 px regardless of a size prop.
